THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat Compass/Redfin/SIR About on STRUCTURE, not scale. OPEN on the firm story (small boutique brokerage · all of Central Oregon · help clients buy and sell) plus an optional Bend office exterior / mission band. Then client reviews as the primary proof (Google score + featured quote — never press). Then dated local closings. Then Contact four-up Call|Text|Email|Schedule. Then a short Who you work with teaser that only doors to /team. Then a compact inquiry that GET-submits to Contact. FAIL if the page opens on brokers' faces or three equal broker Cards. About is the brokerage, not Meet the Team. Skip coast-to-coast, Redfin fee, and Rocket copy. Never invent MOS, prices, or licenses.

beats.text: Firm story opens the page: small boutique brokerage, all of Central Oregon, help clients buy and sell. Not a staff-directory fold.
Firm reviews: brokerage Google record as words (V3Proof), with a door to /reviews.
Firm closings: recent Ryan Realty sales as house-row cards (photo, address, ClosePrice, beds/baths/sqft). Never invent MOS.
Call is the primary conversion on the reach control, carrying live hours.
Text sits on the same reach control as Call, not a seven-row phone book.
Email sits on the same reach control as Call, Text, and Schedule.
Schedule sits on the same reach control as Call, Text, and Email.
Team teaser doors only to /team; compact inquiry GET /contact. No /team/[slug] on About. Brokers are not the opener.

note: SITE-90 2026-09-12 Matt lock + Researchy 1–8. About = brokerage, not Meet the Team. Synced with PR 214 competitiveBrief (about-researchy-1-8). requiredComponents opener is AboutFirm, not AboutFaces. Order: AboutFirm hero, V3Proof reviews PRIMARY, FirmClosings, V3Doors Call/Text/Email/Schedule, AboutTeamTeaser → /team only, AboutInquiry GET /contact, Atlas, Quiet #about, V3Answers, Footer. No deep bios or licenses on the fold. No V3Instrument. No V3SourceLine on the fold.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: AboutPage + aboutOrganization + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON-LD. V3Quiet and V3Instrument carry no structured data of their own.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > About. Surface tone (cream under the firm-story hero, not a dark Stage). Current page never a link.

requiredComponents.name: AboutFirm
requiredComponents.section: OPENS THE PAGE. Firm story + mood: optional full-bleed Bend office exterior (115 NW Oregon Ave #2, never the sofa) with H1 and one purpose line — small boutique brokerage, all of Central Oregon, help buy and sell. Navy/cream. NOT three broker Cards. NOT Meet the Team. A Google score may link to /reviews as supporting proof; the primary reviews beat is V3Proof.

requiredComponents.name: V3Proof
requiredComponents.section: PRIMARY client-reviews proof. Google score + featured quote as words, headingLevel 2, door to /reviews. Same DAL read (getReviews). Do not muddle with press. Do not invent a rating. The count and average are sourced or omitted.

requiredComponents.name: FirmClosings
requiredComponents.section: SALES PROOF. Recent local closings as V3Carousel / shadcn carousel (Card slides: photo, address, recorded ClosePrice, close date, beds/baths/sqft, listing door). Dated sold homes from the firm record. Not national scale counts. Never invent MOS or prices. Child of the page so about/page.tsx never mounts a city-stats Ledger.

requiredComponents.name: V3Doors
requiredComponents.section: #reach four-up matching Contact: Call | Text | Email | Schedule. `primary` on the call door (display scale) with V3OnDuty live hours; text, email and Schedule as the lighter alternatives. Replaces the seven-row contact list SITE-48 removed.

requiredComponents.name: AboutTeamTeaser
requiredComponents.section: Short Who you work with teasers AFTER the firm story. Photo + name only. Every card and the Meet the team door go to /team only. No deep bios, licenses, Call rows, or /team/[slug] doors. Licenses live on Team / broker heroes.

requiredComponents.name: AboutInquiry
requiredComponents.section: One short inquiry on About. Native GET to /contact?inquiry=. Label Send a message. Not a second ContactAsk. Full form stays on Contact.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Once: #about, late — a short origin plus the firm and principal-broker licences as sourced facts, never a KPI Instrument. The second instance (#who, seven contact rows as the fold) was deleted by SITE-48; the reach it carried is the V3Doors reach control.

requiredComponents.name: V3Answers
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 8, closing. The same ABOUT_FAQ_ITEMS array the FAQPage JSON-LD emits, as native disclosures, with the three edges /about has not offered yet (Value my home, Homes for sale, Central Oregon housing market) in the left rail. Replaces the closing V3Quiet 2026-09-02: as prose it measured 1,491px at 1440 with 8 paragraphs, no figure and no control, which is the wall of text TASTE.md bans by name, and four of those paragraphs restated a section above them. The D11 mission sentence went with them — VOICE.md permits it on About and requires it nowhere, and it opened on smallness positioning. No answer moved behind script: a closed disclosure is still in the served HTML.

requiredComponents.name: V3Atlas
requiredComponents.section: The service area as the living map: every town, community, and Bend neighborhood with a recorded boundary as a door, the region's listings as dots, one claim sentence from the same population the homepage hero reads (buildPlaceAtlas, one source). Replaces the city ledger 2026-09-02 (Matt: every page interactive, no scrolling lists).

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. Rendered OUTSIDE <main> so the footer maps to role=contentinfo.

requiredComponents.name: V3OnDuty
requiredComponents.section: The live state on the reach control: our published booking hours against the Pacific clock, from the same crm_company_settings.booking_hours rows /book offers time from. NEVER a reply-time figure — see components/site/v3/V3OnDuty.view.ts and SITE-09.
